name: todo-list
description: Plan trees written by Claude through a plan tool, shown in a pane and status line with live activity.

enforce.title: Enforce plan
enforce.description: Block state-changing tools until a plan exists

stopCheck.title: Stop check
stopCheck.description: When Claude stops with plan steps still pending or in progress, send it back to finish or update them (at most twice a turn)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Also show the plan and live activity as a status line under the prompt

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Theme key or color for the current step, progress bar and running state (for example claude, magenta, green, #c084fc)
